title: 第11章 我在下界有个门路风险是大了点不过利润很高第12章 公示
slug: 西游平账大圣在我贪亿点咋了
content_zh:
高大上的概念抛出来，已经将二人震慑住。
苏元接下来讲的就是真正的“焚诀”
了。
“我们要做的，就是把所有散仙游贩的需求收集起来，由我们统一进行大宗采买，压低进价。
然后划定品类，我们独家专卖，控制出货价。
低买高卖，垄断生意，赚取稳定且巨大的差价。
这叫平台化运营，供应链整合，最终实现渠道为王！”
墨麒麟尊者听得眼中精光爆闪，猛地一拍大腿。
“妙啊！
此言大善！
如此一来，定价权便彻底掌握在我等手中！
哈哈哈！”
他心情大好，喊道。
“倒酒！
快倒酒！
我要与苏小友畅饮一番！”
赤脚大仙一听有酒喝，也乐了，连忙从怀里掏出几枚火枣摆在桌上佐酒。
酒过三巡，气氛热络了不少。
苏元趁机试探着问道。
“尊者，请恕下官多嘴一问，您要赚这么多灵石，是所为何事？以您的身份，似乎……”

墨麒麟闻言，脸上竟露出一丝惆怅，仰头闷下一杯仙酿，叹道：
“唉！
苏兄弟，你有所不知，哥哥我也有难处啊！”
“有人的地方，就有江湖。
有兽的地方，他妈的也有江湖啊！”
他语气激动起来，絮叨个不停。
“在我们坐骑圈、神兽圈，那也是分三六九等，有鄙视链的！”
“那头老青牛我就不提了。”
“真武大帝座下那龟蛇二将，那也是陪着北帝一起成道的！
确实资历老，功劳大！”
“但是现在就连赵公明的黑虎、黄飞虎的五色神牛，跟我一起封神之战上天的平辈之交，个个都神气起来。
平日里出门哪个不是出手阔绰，浑身披挂顶级法宝？”
“嗨，世风日下，兽心不古。
现在的坐骑都太物质了，兜里没有几万灵石，出门我都抬不起头。”
“你再看看哥哥我！”
墨麒麟越说越委屈。
“我们家老爷，干的都是些什么王八蛋的活？”
“不是在到处找线索，就是在查案！
要么就是渡劫去劈人，尽是些得罪人又没油水的苦差事！
清廉是清廉了，可……”
content_en:
The lofty concept was thrown out and already shocked the two of them.
What Su Yuan talks about next is the real "burning technique"
.
“What we have to do is to collect the needs of all the Sanxian vendors, and let us purchase them in bulk to lower the purchase price.
Then we define the categories, sell them exclusively, and control the shipping price.
Buy low and sell high, monopolize the business, and earn stable and huge price differences.
This is called platform operation, supply chain integration, and ultimately realizing that channels are king! "
Venerable Mo Qilin's eyes flashed when he heard this, and he slapped his thigh suddenly.
"Wonderful!
This is a great thing to say!
In this way, the pricing power is completely in our hands!
Hahaha! "
he shouted in a good mood.
“Pour the wine!
Pour the wine quickly!
I want to have a drink with Su Xiaoyou! "
When the Barefoot Immortal heard that there was wine to drink, he was also happy. He quickly took out a few fire dates from his arms and placed them on the table to accompany the wine.
After three drinks, the atmosphere became much more lively.
Su Yuan took the opportunity to ask tentatively.
"Your Majesty, please forgive me for asking, why do you want to earn so many spiritual stones? With your status, it seems..."
When Mo Qilin heard this, a hint of melancholy appeared on his face. He raised his head and drank a cup of fairy brew, sighing:
"Alas!
Brother Su, you don’t know something. Brother, I am also in trouble! "
“Wherever there are people, there are rivers and lakes.
Where there are beasts, there are also fucking rivers and lakes! "
His tone became excited and he kept talking.
"In our mount circle and mythical beast circle, there are also three, six or nine levels, and there are chains of contempt!"
"I won't mention that old green cow."
"The two generals, turtle and snake, under Emperor Zhenwu, also accompanied Beidi to achieve enlightenment!
Indeed, he has seniority and great contributions! "
“But now, even Zhao Gongming’s black tiger, Huang Feihu’s five-color sacred bull, and my peers who joined me in the Conferred God Battle are all very proud.
Who doesn't spend a lot of money and wear top-notch magic weapons when they go out on weekdays? "
"Hey, the world is getting worse, and the beast's heart is not the same as before.
Today’s mounts are too materialistic. I don’t have tens of thousands of spiritual stones in my pocket. I can’t even lift my head when I go out. "
"Look at me again, brother!"
The more Mo Qilin talked, the more aggrieved he became.
"What kind of bastard's work does our master do?"
“If I’m not looking for clues everywhere, I’m investigating a case!
Or go through tribulations and hack people, which is all boring and boring work that offends people!
Integrity is incorruptibility, but..."
